userRequest: Prevent a customer from buying the same product more than once. A later paid-order attempt for the same customer and product must fail before payment, while purchases of another product remain allowed.
publicAcceptanceCriteria: The first paid order for a customer and product succeeds with the existing observable records.
A second order for the same customer and product returns 409 with code REPEAT_PURCHASE and does not consume a payment outcome or create state.
The customer can still order a different product, and a different customer can order the original product.
Concurrent duplicate attempts cannot both succeed.

expectedPublicSurfaces.behavior: Enforce uniqueness of the customer-product purchase pair.
